note: Synthetic acceptance cases. Each runs ORCA's real decision code for one enforcement path. A pass says what ORCA answers on that path; it does not say what the agent then ran. That is the connected proof's job.

categories.lifecycle: A grant, revocation, expiry or edit decides the very next call, and repeats are decided one by one
categories.failure: Anything ORCA cannot read or decide ends in a block or an ask, never in a run
categories.arguments: A changed tool, resource, command or directory is a new decision
categories.bypass: Routes around the policy: ORCA's own files, links, shell grants, slipped-in wildcards
categories.privacy: What a route's answer hands back to the agent never carries the call's input. Events, logs and stored records are not checked here

cases.title: A remembered grant is decided again on every identical call, and the call after a revocation is not allowed
A timed grant stops allowing the moment it expires
A recorded "always reject" denies the next identical call, ahead of the default allow, and nothing else
An operator's policy edit between two identical calls decides the second
Identical concurrent calls are each decided, and every call started after a revocation asks
An unreadable sidecar turns its grants and later allows into asks, and configured denials still deny
A deleted sidecar takes its grants with it
An ask with nobody to answer, or whose turn ends while waiting, runs nothing
Malformed, mistyped or oversized tool-call input blocks
A missing, unreadable, unknown-version or oversized session context blocks every call
The hook is installed for every tool, without a shell, with a bounded timeout and block-on-failure
A rule allow is delivered as a one-time answer only; an ask offering no one-time allow is refused, not widened
Tools ORCA does not know, and malformed MCP names, are asked about
A grant for one MCP tool covers neither another tool nor the same tool on another server
A changed target outside the workspace, including through .., is a new decision
A denied command is denied in every spelling ORCA parses, and no other command is allowed
A granted call running outside the workspace asks
Writes to ORCA's own files (config, sidecar, session state) are denied even under default allow
A link inside the workspace does not open ORCA's files
No shell command is allowed by a standing grant, recorded or hand-written
A wildcard allow slipped into the sidecar allows nothing
A dangling link inside the workspace does not let a write create one of ORCA's files
Ask and deny answers never carry the call's command, content, arguments or path
Failure answers never echo the input or the session context
Every answer is short and fixed-form, whatever the input's size
Credentials are unreadable under default allow, directly or through a link
